chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Husayn, from some of his companions, from Abi ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
If a man is split into two halves, salat (prayer) is performed over the half in which the heart is.

key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: the man or male deceased being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.الَّذِي: the part which is being specified
key_terms.الْقَلْبُ: the heart, used here as the determining bodily marker
key_terms.وُسِّطَ: was divided through the middle into two parts

ai.seo_question: If a dead body is found split into two halves, over which part should funeral salat (prayer) be performed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning funeral salat (prayer) when a human body is found divided into two halves. It specifies that the salat (prayer) is to be performed over the half that contains the heart, indicating its legal significance in identifying the body for this rite.
